About Nintendo eShop
Manual
About Nintendo eShop
Nintendo eShop is an internet shop where you can purchase Wii U downloadable software and add-on content. You can also read up on software, watch related videos and download demo versions.
◆ You will need to add funds before you can purchase software. 8
◆ If your Wii U console and Nintendo 3DS™ system are both linked to the same Nintendo Network™ ID, its funds and account activity will be shared across both devices.
Software that you can purchase
● Wii U downloadable software
This includes Wii U download-only software, and downloadable versions of Wii U disc software.
● Virtual Console
This is software from past consoles such as the NES™ and Super NES™.
Virtual Console Loyalty Offer

Wii U versions of Virtual Console™ titles are offered at a reduced price to users who already own the Wii™ versions of those titles on their Wii U console. This applies to titles that have been purchased using the Wii Shop Channel on the Wii Menu of the respective Wii U console, and titles that were transferred to the respective Wii U console from a Wii console. For further details about this offer, please refer to the Nintendo® website.

◆ You can restrict the use of Nintendo eShop in the following ways using Parental Controls on the Wii U Menu. To open the Wii U Electronic Manual, on the Wii U Menu, press to open the HOME Menu, then select (Manual).

Contents
Touch MENU on the menu bar to view information and configure settings.
● Help
Manual
Displays the manual.
About Nintendo eShop
Displays details about the Nintendo eShop service.
Customer Support
View a list of customer support contacts. Be sure to check these carefully before contacting them.
● Add funds8
Watch List
The software you've added to your watch list will be displayed here.
Touch a software icon to see more details about that software.6
Touch VIEW LIST to see a list of software you've added to your watch list.
◆ You can add up to 200 software titles to the watch list.
Submit Reviews
The software you can review will be displayed here.
Touch a software icon to review software you have played. You will be asked to answer three questions, such as how many stars you would give the game.
Touch VIEW LIST to see a list of software you can review.
Totals for the reviews will be displayed in Software Information6, Charts12and so on.
◆ You can submit one review per software title for each user. You can only submit reviews for software once you have played the software for at least an hour.
◆ You cannot submit reviews for software if the age registered for your user falls under the age range allowed by the game rating for the software.
◆ There are certain software titles for which you cannot submit reviews.
◆ You can view your reviews in YOUR REVIEWS.
History
● Your Downloads
Here you can view or redownload the software and add-on content that you have already downloaded.
● Account Activity
View records such as those for purchased software or added funds. Touch VIEW RECEIPT to check receipts.

◆ After linking the same Nintendo Network ID to your Wii U console and Nintendo 3DS system, the Account Activity of both will be shared on the ID. However, Account Activity on your Nintendo 3DS system from prior to linking the ID will not be displayed in Nintendo eShop on your Wii U console.
Settings
● Notifications
Choose whether you would like to receive notifications from Nintendo eShop on the Wii U Menu.
● Address Information
You can update and delete your address information using this option.
◆ Your address information is used to calculate tax on your software purchases.
◆ The address you've entered will only be used in Nintendo eShop.
● Language

◆ Language changes will only apply to Nintendo eShop.

Watching Videos
Select videos from screens such as the title information screen to watch software-related videos.
1 Pause / play button
Touch to pause the video, and again to resume playback.
2 Play bar
Change the playback position. Slide to move the playback position backwards or forwards in the video.

◆ Video or audio may be interrupted during playback depending on the quality of the internet connection.

Adding Funds
Manual
Adding Funds
Touch BALANCE on the menu bar to display the screen to add funds.
◆ Balances are individual to each user.
You will need either of the following to add funds:
Nintendo eShop Card
Credit card
◆ If your Wii U console and Nintendo 3DS system are both linked to the same Nintendo Network ID, you will be able to use funds added through the Wii U console in Nintendo eShop for Nintendo 3DS.
Add funds using a Nintendo eShop Card
Select this option if you wish to add funds from a Nintendo eShop Card.
Add funds using a credit card

Select this option if you wish to add funds using a credit card. You can view the receipt in MENU ⇒ ACCOUNT ACTIVITY.4
You can save your credit card information. Once you've saved credit card information, you can use it the next time you add funds simply by entering the password you set when first storing the information.
◆ Please note that if you incorrectly enter the password used for your credit card information three times in a row, your credit card information will be deleted for security reasons.
◆ If you have forgotten your password, please delete your credit card information and save it again.
View Credit Card Information
You can view and delete your stored credit card information using this option.

◆ Users under the age of 18 cannot use a credit card. If you are under 18 and purchasing something with a credit card, make sure you get permission from a parent or guardian. Follow the instructions on screen to make a purchase.
Limits on Adding Funds
View the limits on adding funds here.

Purchasing Add-on Content and Passes
Manual
Purchasing Add-on Content and Passes
You can purchase add-on content or passes for a software title on the title information screen. 9
Purchasing Add-on Content
You can purchase add-on content, if available, for a software title.
● Search Add-on Content
Search the available add-on content for the software using filters such as keywords, genre or price.
● Add-on content list
Touch to display more information about the add-on content.
● Tick box
Touch next to add-on content you'd like to buy to tick it. Then touch VIEW SELECTED ITEMS, and purchase the add-on content by following the on-screen guide.
◆ The prices and types of add-on content will differ depending on the software title.
◆ You can view your add-on content purchase history in MENU ⇒ ACCOUNT ACTIVITY.4
◆ Add-on content cannot be returned, refunded or exchanged.
◆ Once you have purchased add-on content, you can redownload it free of charge if you delete it.
◆ You will not be able to redownload add-on content if you delete your Nintendo Network ID.
◆ Please be aware that it is not possible to redownload content if distribution of that content has been suspended or terminated.
◆ Purchased add-on content will be saved to the same location that the corresponding software is saved.
◆ Add-on content purchased by one user can be shared between all the users linked to that console.
Purchasing Passes
You can buy passes if there are any available services that require them.

Passes have expiry periods which begin from the time of purchase. If you buy an additional pass before the end of the expiry period, the number of days you purchased will be added to the end of the current expiry period.

Q&A
Manual
Q&A
● Purchasing Software

Q

How do I pay for software?

A

The cost of the software will be deducted from your balance of funds. These funds can be added to by using Nintendo eShop Cards or credit cards.

Q

How do I use coupons?

A

If you have received a coupon code (e.g. as part of a special offer), touch the REDEEM COUPON option on the purchase screen, then proceed according to the on-screen instructions.

Q

What can I use to add funds?
A
You can use the following (subject to availability of these functions in each country):
Nintendo eShop Card
Credit card
You cannot use the following:
Wii Points Card™
Nintendo Points Card™

Q

Where can I buy a Nintendo eShop Card?

A

Nintendo eShop Cards can be bought from retail outlets that sell Nintendo products.

Q

How do I use Nintendo eShop Cards?

A

Scratch the back of the card to reveal the concealed 16-digit activation code. Enter this code to add funds.8

Q

What kinds of credit card can I use?

A

You can use VISA® and MasterCard® credit cards.

Q

Can I use Wii Points™ from the Wii Shop Channel to make purchases?

A

You cannot. Wii Points may only be used in the Wii Shop Channel.

Q

Can I make purchases with my funds from Nintendo eShop for Nintendo 3DS?

A

You can, as long as your Wii U console and Nintendo 3DS system are both linked to the same Nintendo Network ID.

Q

Where can I check codes issued to me when I purchase software?

A

You can check them on the receipt. To do this go to MENU ⇒ ACCOUNT ACTIVITY ⇒ VIEW RECEIPT from the Nintendo eShop menu bar. You can find them under Issued Codes on the receipt.

Q

Can I view the Account Activity for the Nintendo 3DS system I have linked to my Nintendo Network ID?

A

Yes, although Account Activity on your Nintendo 3DS system from prior to linking the ID will not be displayed on your Wii U console.
● Software

Q

Are manuals available for software acquired from Nintendo eShop?

A

They are. Open the HOME Menu while software is running, and select MANUAL to view the electronic manual.

Q

Do I have to pay to redownload purchased software?

A

You do not – unless you have deleted your Nintendo Network ID. Please be aware that it is not possible to redownload content if distribution of that content has been suspended or terminated.
● Data Management

Q

How long will it take for purchased software to download?

A

Depending on the size of the data and your internet connection, it may take some time to complete downloads.
You can view the download progress by starting Download Management from the HOME Menu.

Q

Where is downloaded software saved?

A

It will be saved to the system memory or a USB storage device. Software cannot be saved to SD Cards.

Q

Can software be moved or copied between the system memory and a USB storage device?

A

It can. For more information, see System Settings ⇒ Data Management from the Wii U Menu.
● Customer Support

Q

Where can I get customer support?

A

The contact for customer support will vary depending on your needs. Consult MENU ⇒ HELP ⇒ CUSTOMER SUPPORT.4

How Totals Are Calculated
Manual
How Totals Are Calculated
Totals for user ratings in Submit Reviews or the number of times videos are watched are calculated according to the following criteria.
● User Ratings
An average is calculated from the user reviews received via Submit Reviews and displayed in half-star units.
◆ Reviews for a software title will be shown after the first review has been processed.
◆ In order to calculate the average more accurately, the highest and lowest 5% of the ratings are ignored during calculation.
● Software Charts
The number of submissions for each title is totalled, and titles that have received at least twenty submissions are displayed in order of the highest user ratings.
● Video Charts
The number of times a video has been viewed on Nintendo eShop is totalled, and the videos are displayed in order of the highest number of views.
Timing of Updates
The totals are recalculated and updated every three hours. (New reviews and video views are not reflected in the total immediately.)
◆ Depending on system conditions, calculation time may change or updates may take more time to be reflected in Nintendo eShop.
